content.title: About
content.content: Hard pretzels are baked wheat flour snacks known for their golden crust and iconic knot shape. They have a slightly salty taste, a crunchy texture, and are commonly enjoyed as a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pretzels originated in Europe, and their shape is said to represent crossed arms in prayer.
Hard pretzels are often sprinkled with coarse sea salt or flavored with spices such as paprika and garlic.
In the United States more than 2 billion pretzels are consumed each year.
Mini‑pretzel bites are popular for office snack packs.
There is a World Pretzel Day celebrated on April 26.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Hard pretzels provide quick‑digesting carbs for an immediate energy boost.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Unlike many snack foods, they contain little fat when baked without added oils.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The wheat flour used supplies a modest amount of iron, supporting blood formation.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain versions add fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: B vitamins
items.content: Pretzels can contribute thiamine and niacin, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Because of their simple carbs, pretzels can cause a rapid rise in blood sugar.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The salty coating may be a concern for those monitoring sodium intake.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Pretzels contain gluten and are unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: While low in fat, large portions can add up in calories.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Hard pretzels are convenient as a standalone snack, paired with cheese, mustard, hummus, or used to add crunch to salads and soups.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, store in the refrigerator to prevent drying out.
